repeated_seed_protocol.selection_policy: Fixed grid [0.01, 1, 10, 100]; validation MSE selects within each dataset; first minimum wins. No test tuning or seed exclusion. Selected penalty frozen for all expanding refits. MLP settings and initialization seed fixed.
repeated_seed_protocol.aggregation: Equal weight per independent process seed. Sample SD (ddof=1), MCSE of mean = SD/sqrt(n), linear empirical p10/p90. Quantiles describe dataset variability, not confidence or prediction intervals. Regimes paired by innovations; days are not independent replicates.

feature_ablation_protocol.selection_policy: Four fixed feature variants; alpha grid [0.01, 1, 10, 100]. Training-only scaling and coefficients. Validation MSE selects alpha separately per variant, then selects a variant. First minimum wins, full ridge first. Calibration sets each frozen model's 90% residual radius; test only scores. No test ranking selects a deployed variant; no refits or seed exclusions.
feature_ablation_protocol.aggregation: Equal weight per process seed; stable/stress share innovations. Sample SD (ddof=1), MCSE=SD/sqrt(n), linear empirical p10/p90 and range. Paired differences subtract full ridge within seed; lower_count counts negative differences (lower coverage is a failure, not a win).

isolation_audit.scope: First listed process seed, stable history; deterministic row perturbations, not independent datasets.
isolation_audit.interventions: Test features = 100+7*x; test targets += 1000; calibration targets += 1000; excluded features and targets += 1000. Separate interventions on copies.

training_only_audit.intervention: Only test rows: x0=1000+10*x0, x1=-500+20*x1, y=100-7*y; constant unchanged

leaky_control.description: Incorrect full-data scaler, same training labels and fixed original selected alpha

provenance.data: Synthetic AR(1) series with a prescribed coefficient shift
provenance.cost_assumptions: Local CPU and NumPy only; no paid services. Runtime, energy and monetary cost not measured.

limitations: Single synthetic series and a single prescribed shift; not a financial forecasting result.
A one-row gap handles these one-step labels, not arbitrary overlapping targets.
Repeated model development can overfit a fixed holdout; fresh confirmation is a later milestone.
